newsitem.title: USA: Tsongas stable after liver surgery - U.S. hospital.
newsitem.headline: Tsongas stable after liver surgery - U.S. hospital.

text.p: Former U.S. Senator Paul Tsongas was in stable condition on Saturday at Brigham and Women's Hospital one day after surgery to treat a liver problem, a hospital spokeswoman said.
No further information was available at the request of the family, the spokeswoman said.
Tsongas, 55, a former Democratic presidential contender, entered the hospital on Jan. 3 suffering from a liver disorder that was related to previous bone marrow transplants, the spokeswoman said.
